ValidationRule.description: Dealer account field is mandatory when Customer journey is refer to dealer
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Nurture"), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost") ), ISPICKVAL(Customer_Journey__c, "Refer to Dealer"), ISBLANK(DealerAccount__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill Dealer filed with a Dealer account as Customer Journey is Refer to Delear
